Gestione dei prodotti del software di testa - Automazione del laboratorio e manipolazione dei liquidi (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'interno del nostro team di Product Management, definirete e guidare la strategia software di Tecan per il nostro portafoglio prodotti di gestione dei liquidi. In qualità di responsabile della gestione dei prodotti software, collaborerai la gestione dei prodotti e la R&D, assicurando che le decisioni architettoniche e di prodotto servano sia alle esigenze dei clienti che agli obiettivi aziendali. Costruirai, svilupperai e guiderai un team di gestione del prodotto di software altamente performante, sostenendo una cultura di collaborazione, inclusione e responsabilità.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione - leader cambiamento, lo sviluppo delle persone, e prendere decisioni critiche sull'assunzione, la struttura del team e la gestione delle prestazioni. La vostra capacità di eseguire, impostare la direzione chiara e fornire risultati misurabili sarà essenziale in quanto si guida miglioramenti della piattaforma e garantire che i nostri prodotti software soddisfano i più elevati standard di qualità e conformità.

responsabilità

• Guidare, sviluppare e mantenere un team di gestione dei prodotti software di alta qualità attraverso una chiara direzione, coaching e pianificazione di successione.

• Promuovere una cultura di squadra collaborativa, inclusiva e ad alta responsabilità.

• Intuizione del cliente campione e consapevolezza competitiva come la base per tutte le decisioni del prodotto software.

• Guida la strategia software di Tecan e la roadmap del prodotto, bilanciando la consegna a breve termine con la salute della piattaforma a lungo termine.

• Servire come controparte del prodotto dedicato per l'architettura del software all'interno della R&D, assicurando i requisiti definiti dal business.

• Servire come voce di prodotto nelle decisioni architettoniche in tutti gli strati del software, assicurando il controllo, l'orchestrazione, middleware, le applicazioni e le integrazioni in linea con i requisiti definiti dal business

• Lead build vs. buy vs. valutazioni dei partner per componenti software e funzionalità della piattaforma.

Il tuo sfondo

Non stiamo solo cercando competenze difficili: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• Una laurea in Software/Computer Science, Ingegneria, o un campo tecnico correlato; un grado avanzato o MBA è un plus.

• 5-7 anni di esperienza di gestione del prodotto, idealmente in Scienze della vita, Diagnostica, Dispositivi medici, o industrie connesse all'hardware.

• Forte esperienza di leadership, tra cui l'assunzione, lo sviluppo e la gestione di team.

• Esperienza con ecosistemi informatici di laboratorio (LIMS, ELN, standard di integrazione come SiLA2, OPC-UA, o simili).

• Profonda comprensione tecnica delle API, sistemi distribuiti, middleware, orchestrazione e sistemi incorporati.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione in inglese; tedesco o altre lingue sono un plus.

• pensiero strategico combinato con l'esecuzione hands-on e una mentalità orientata verso l'obiettivo.

• Esperienza con metodologie Agile e moderne pratiche di sviluppo software.

• Conoscenza degli standard normativi e di qualità (ad esempio, ISO, FDA, GDPR).

• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale come richiesto.

Cappello W fa lavorare a Tecan unico

La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

Gestion des produits de Head Software - Automatisation des laboratoires et manipulation des liquides (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Votre contribution

Dans ce rôle de leader central au sein de notre équipe de gestion de produits, vous définirez et piloterez la stratégie logicielle Tecans pour notre portefeuille de produits de manutention de liquides. En tant que chef de la gestion des produits logiciels, vous établirez un lien entre la gestion des produits et la R-D, en veillant à ce que les décisions en matière d'architecture et de produits répondent aux besoins des clients et aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous créerez, développerez et dirigerez une équipe de gestion des produits logiciels hautement performante, défendant une culture de collaboration, d'inclusion et de responsabilité.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation : diriger le changement, former des gens et prendre des décisions cruciales en matière d'embauche, de structure d'équipe et de gestion du rendement. Votre capacité d'exécuter, de définir une direction claire et de fournir des résultats mesurables sera essentielle car vous conduisez des améliorations de plate-forme et assurez que nos produits logiciels répondent aux normes les plus élevées de qualité et de conformité.

Responsabilités

• Diriger, développer et conserver une équipe de gestion de produits logiciels hautement performante grâce à une direction claire, un encadrement et une planification de la relève.

• Favoriser une culture d'équipe collaborative, inclusive et hautement responsable.

• Compréhension des clients champions et sensibilisation concurrentielle comme base pour toutes les décisions de produits logiciels.

• Diriger la stratégie logicielle et la feuille de route des produits de Tecan, en conciliant la prestation à court terme et la santé à long terme des plateformes.

• Servir d'équivalent de produit dédié à l'architecture de logiciels dans la R-D, en veillant à ce que les exigences définies par les entreprises soient respectées.

• Servir de voix de produit dans les décisions architecturales de toutes les couches de logiciels, en assurant le contrôle, l'orchestration, le middleware, les applications et les intégrations conformes aux exigences définies par les entreprises

• Lead build vs. buy vs. partner évaluations pour les composants logiciels et les capacités de plate-forme.

Vos antécédents

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement des compétences difficiles: Nous recherchons des gens qui apportent leur passion et leur talent au travail.

• Un diplôme en logiciel / informatique, en génie, ou un domaine technique connexe; un diplôme avancé ou MBA est un plus.

• 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits, idéalement dans les sciences de la vie, les diagnostics, les matériels médicaux ou les industries liées au matériel.

• Forte expérience en leadership, y compris l'embauche, le développement et la gestion d'équipes.

• Expérience des écosystèmes informatiques de laboratoire (LIMS, ELN, normes d'intégration telles que SiLA2, OPC-UA, ou similaire).

• Compréhension technique approfondie des API, des systèmes distribués, des intergiciels, de l'orchestration et des systèmes embarqués.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation en anglais; l'allemand ou d'autres langues sont un plus.

• La pensée stratégique combinée avec l'exécution pratique et un état d'esprit orienté vers l'objectif.

• Expérience des méthodologies Agiles et des pratiques modernes de développement de logiciels.

• Connaissance des normes de réglementation et de qualité (p. ex. ISO, FDA, RGPD).

• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger au besoin.

W chapeau rend travailler à Tecan unique

La chance de le faire compter et d'avoir un impact sur le monde de demain

• Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié

• La chance de développer votre carrière au sein de l'entreprise

• Se sentir autonomisé par notre culture d'entreprise forte et unique

• Ensemble complet de rémunération et de prestations

Rejoignez Tecan, un excellent endroit pour travailler ! Lisez notre récente certification de Great Place to Work .

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande en ligne. Veuillez soumettre votre CV ou votre curriculum vitae (w/o photo et w/o lettre de motivation, lettres de référence et diplômes sont facultatifs).

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Production Team und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Production Engineer (100%)

Männedorf, Schweiz

Dein Beitrag

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle tragen Sie die technische Verantwortung für ein Produkteportfolio während dem Lifecycle-Management. Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis und Leidenschaft für komplexe Systeme sowie dem Drang nach steter Verbesserung tragen Sie massgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Produkte stets höchsten Kundenansprüchen genügen. Sie stehen als Schnittstelle im Zentrum zwischen der internen/externen Produktion, Forschung & Entwicklung, Beschaffung, Produkt-Management und Qualitätssicherung.

• Definition und Entwicklung der MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Prozesse

• End-to-End Implementierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung des MES

• Verantwortung für Projekt- und Teilprojektmanagement bei komplexen MES-Implementierungen und Rollouts

• Technische Betreuung der zugeteilten Produkte von der Freigabe der Nullserie bis zum Phase-out.

• Initiierung und Umsetzung von mechanischen, elektronischen oder Softwareänderungen zusammen mit einem Team von Fachexperten.

• Fehleranalyse und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Planung und Leitung von Prozess Validierungen in unserer Produktion oder bei Lieferanten.

• Entwicklung und Planung der benötigten Produktions- und Prüfmittel

• Prozessbetreuung und -steuerung der zugewiesenen Produktionslinien durch Überwachung der Kennzahlen

• Sicherstellen der Datenqualität im ERP System für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung

• Mitarbeit in LCM-Projekten, um die produktionstechnischen Aspekte einzubringen

• Unterstützung der Qualitätssicherung in technischen Fragen

• Unterstützung des Einkaufs bei technischen Fragen und Aktivitäten mit Lieferanten und Sub-Lieferanten

Dein Profil

• Motivation und Eigenverantwortung, um unsere Produkte und Produktionsprozesse stetig zu verbessern.

• Ingenieur Studium (Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Systemtechnik oder Produktionstechnik) oder Techniker/-in HF Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Nebst fachlicher Expertise sind wir auch auf der Suche nach einer Persönlichkeit, welche durch proaktives Handeln und dem Drang nach stetiger Verbesserung hervorsticht.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

·         Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

·         Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

·         Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

·         Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

·         Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work!  Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren.  Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, welche unsere Anforderungen erfüllen.

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Diventa parte del nostro team di produzione e usa il talento e la passione che ti fa.

Ingegnere di produzione (100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo versatile, assumerai la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la vostra comprensione tecnica e la passione per i sistemi complessi e la spinta per un costante miglioramento, contribuite in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti del cliente. Essi servono come interfaccia tra produzione interna / esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia di qualità.

• Definizione e sviluppo dei processi MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

• implementazione end-to-end e ottimizzazione continua del MES

• Responsabilità per la gestione dei progetti e dei sottoprogetti in complesse implementazioni e rollout MES

• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie zero al phase-out.

• Iniziazione e implementazione di cambiamenti meccanici, elettronici o software insieme a un team di esperti.

• Analisi degli errori e attuazione delle misure di miglioramento

• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni di processo nella nostra produzione o nei fornitori.

• Sviluppo e pianificazione delle attrezzature di produzione e di prova richieste

• Supporto del processo e controllo delle linee di produzione assegnate monitorando i dati chiave

• Garantire la qualità dei dati nel sistema ERP per un trattamento regolare degli ordini

• Partecipazione a progetti LCM per la realizzazione degli aspetti produttivi

• Sostegno all'assicurazione della qualità in materia tecnica

• Sostenere l'acquisto con problemi tecnici e attività con fornitori e subfornitori

Il tuo profilo

• Motivazione e responsabilità personale per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti e processi produttivi.

• Ingegneria (ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria dei sistemi o ingegneria di produzione) o tecnico con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale

• Ottima conoscenza dell'ingegneria di produzione, progettazione e logistica

• Esperienza professionale nel settore della tecnologia medica regolamentata/biofarmacia, automazione, automotive e/o aviazione

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Oltre alle competenze tecniche, stiamo anche cercando una personalità che si distingue per l'azione proattiva e la voglia di un costante miglioramento.

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

· L'opportunità di fare la differenza e modellare il mondo di domani

· Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

· Eccitanti opportunità di carriera

· Cultura aziendale forte e unica

· Compensazione attraente e benefici sociali

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui potete scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo solo considerare le applicazioni che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

In this pivotal role, you will take the lead on development projects from end to end, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and achievement of key performance objectives. You will have full ownership and accountability for mid-sized projects, including internal initiatives and customer specific projects.

Responsibilities

• Defining and building project teams with the right cross-functional mix of professional skills.

• Managing the planning, staffing, and execution of development projects for lab automation and clinical diagnostics according to applicable development processes.

• Planning, monitoring, and reporting on complex projects, coordinating interfaces with related projects.

• Ensuring proactive and proper communication within the organization and with stakeholders, including management board members.

• Demonstrating clear leadership within the organization towards all management levels.

• Coordinating team members located across multiple locations.

• Through leadership and methodological competence, ensure efficient implementation and adherence to processes, guidelines, and regulations, such as: ISO 13485, IEC 61010, and the machinery directive (2006/42/EC).

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional team activities across departments to ensure successful delivery of project goals — from feasibility studies and product development through design transfer and industrialization.

• Drive effective stakeholder management and proactively resolve conflicts within the project team and across stakeholders.

Your background

• BSc or MSc in a technical degree in a technical field, preferably in engineering, life sciences, mechanical or electrical disciplines.

• A PhD in Life Sciences, along with project management education, PMP or similar certifications, and training in change management and leadership, will set you apart.

• At least 3 years of experience in project management, preferably in the development of complex instruments or automated solutions for diagnostic applications.

• Experience in product management and business administration is a bonus.

• Fluent in English; additional languages (German and others) are a plus.

You will support the Partnering Business sales teams in contractual and pricing negotiations, outline value propositions, and drive alignment sessions. Your background

• Experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and product/lifecycle management.

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in executing complex contracts.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations.

Senior Manager Key Account Products (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Manager Key Account Products, you are responsible to manage and oversee all business operations related to Key Account OEM customer products of Tecan’s IVD & Life Sciences Partnering Business. You will be the main contact person for key account customer(s) in day-to-day operations, from late-stage development to market launch readiness, managing the product life cycle during multi-year supply phase until end of life/ next generation solution development. Your responsibilities lie in managing the key account partners systems products ensuring product success through quality and supply performance as well as market growth by driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. With your strong customer focus, communication skills and business acumen, you drive customer satisfaction, build long-lasting business partnerships and drive business growth with key accounts.

Responsibilities

• Act as central point of contact for Key Account customers for all day-to-day operational aspects regarding their Systems products, represent the client interests from development to end of life in internal teams

• Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Oversee product profitability and drive improvement measures with stakeholders

• Lead Product Care Team for assigned products and product families, defining and monitoring critical KPIs, regularly reporting to customers and Tecan management

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and continuously seek improvements to Tecan processes

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team and broader organization.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• 5+ years’ experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and/or product/lifecycle management

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Männedorf, Zurich

Männedorf, Switzerland (with extensive travel across EMEA)

Your contribution

As the Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA, you will play a key role in driving Tecan’s growth across the EMEA region. You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing distributor network, ensuring our partners are empowered to deliver advanced laboratory automation solutions to customers in life sciences, applied markets, and clinical diagnostics. By acting as a strategic link between market needs and Tecan’s internal teams, you will help shape business development and product innovation. Your efforts will ensure the successful positioning and adoption of complex technical solutions, while fostering strong, self-sufficient distributor relationships that support Tecan’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Lead the recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of distributor partners across EMEA.

• Develop and execute strategic business plans with each distributor, ensuring alignment with Tecan’s growth objectives.

• Own the full sales cycle—from opportunity generation to project delivery—acting as the primary interface between distribution partners and internal stakeholders.

• Support distributors in customer engagement, including joint visits, presentations, and negotiations.

• Monitor distributor performance, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of sales performance and profitability.

• Provide technical expertise in laboratory automation, instrument configuration, and integrated solutions.

• Deliver high-level technical presentations and participate in key customer discussions.

• Coordinate cross-functional internal stakeholders to ensure successful execution of complex and high-value projects.

• Travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region to support distributor and customer needs.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in technical or natural sciences (molecular biology, physics, engineering, or related fields).

• 5+ years’ experience in life sciences, diagnostics, or laboratory automation, with hands-on exposure to complex lab instruments or automation platforms.

• Proven track record managing or working with distributor networks (ideally across EMEA).

• Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, applications, and customer environments.

• Excellent communication skills in English; French, German, or Arabic are a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region.

• Strategic mindset, resilience, agility, and a collaborative approach to influencing without direct authority.

Ihre Bemühungen werden die erfolgreiche Positionierung und Übernahme komplexer technischer Lösungen sicherstellen und gleichzeitig starke, autarke Vertriebsbeziehungen fördern, die den Ruf von Tecan für Exzellenz und Kundenzufriedenheit unterstützen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Rekrutierung, das Onboarding und das kontinuierliche Leistungsmanagement von Vertriebspartnern in der gesamten EMEA-Region.

• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie mit jedem Vertriebspartner strategische Geschäftspläne, um die Ausrichtung auf die Wachstumsziele von Tecan sicherzustellen.

• Überwachen Sie die Vertriebsleistung, implementieren Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen und fördern Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsleistung und Rentabilität.

• Bereitstellung von technischem Know-how in den Bereichen Laborautomation, Gerätekonfiguration und integrierte Lösungen.

• Liefern Sie hochrangige technische Präsentationen und nehmen Sie an wichtigen Kundengesprächen teil.

• Koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende interne Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung komplexer und hochwertiger Projekte sicherzustellen.

• Reisen Sie ausgiebig (50-70%) durch die EMEA-Region, um die Bedürfnisse von Distributoren und Kunden zu erfüllen.

Dein Hintergrund

Wir suchen nicht nur nach Hard Skills: Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent in die Arbeit bringen.

• Abschluss in technischen oder Naturwissenschaften (Molekularbiologie, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder verwandte Bereiche).

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Diagnostik oder Laborautomation mit praktischem Kontakt zu komplexen Laborinstrumenten oder Automatisierungsplattformen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung oder Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebsnetzwerken (idealerweise in EMEA).

• Starkes Verständnis von Labor-Workflows, Anwendungen und Kundenumgebungen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch; Französisch, Deutsch oder Arabisch sind ein Plus.

• Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, ausgiebig (50-70%) in der EMEA-Region zu reisen.

• Strategische Denkweise, Resilienz, Agilität und ein kollaborativer Ansatz zur Beeinflussung ohne direkte Autorität.

W Hat macht das Arbeiten bei Tecan einzigartig

Die Chance, dass es zählt und einen Einfluss auf die Welt von morgen hat

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Die Chance, Ihre Karriere innerhalb des Unternehmens zu erweitern

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100 %)

Männedorf, Suisse (avec de nombreux voyages à travers l'EMEA)

En tant que directeur régional des ventes et des distributeurs, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la croissance de Tecan dans toute la région de l'EMEA. • Expérience éprouvée en gestion ou en collaboration avec des réseaux de distributeurs (idéalement dans toute l'EMEA).

• Une bonne compréhension des flux de travail en laboratoire, des applications et des environnements clients.

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais; français, allemand ou arabe sont un plus.

• Volonté et capacité de voyager largement (50 à 70 %) dans toute la région de l'EMEA.

• L'état d'esprit stratégique, la résilience, l'agilité et une approche collaborative pour influencer sans autorité directe.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our People & Organization team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Junior HR BP/ HR Project Specialist (80%, Fix-Term 16 months)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As Junior HR BP/HR Project Specialist you will support the Head Strategic People Partnering and HR HQ in delivering key HR projects and strategic business partnering deliverables. This 16-month fixed-term assignment combines project work with generalist HR responsibilities – ideal for someone who works in a structured way, takes ownership, and thinks about HR holistically. It offers deep insight into strategic HR work in a globally active life sciences company.

Your Responsibilities

HR Projects & Strategic Business Partnering Support (approx. 70%)

• Contribute to global and local HR projects and initiatives (e.g., organizational design, HR process improvements, change support)

• Prepare HR deliverables linked to strategic business partnering, such as business reviews, townhall materials, divisional HR presentations, decision papers, and communication documents

• Project planning and tracking: milestones, action logs, risks, status reports

• Prepare and follow up on workshops, steering committees, and stakeholder meetings

• Compile HR KPIs and people analytics (e.g., fill grades, attrition, pulse survey results)

HR Generalist (approx. 30%)

• Advise and support line managers on operational HR matters across the employee lifecycle, in coordination with the responsible HR Business Partners

• Support recruiting and onboarding processes

• Draft contracts, agreements, and HR documents

• Act as interface to HR Services, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Centers of Expertise

Salary: CHF 80’000

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Completed education with further qualification in HR (e.g., Swiss federal diploma in HR, CAS/Bachelor's degree in HR or Business Administration)

• 3–5+ years of experience as an HR Generalist, ideally in an international, matrix-organized environment

• Experience contributing to or leading HR projects

• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills; confident working with HR systems (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday)

• Strong interest to push AI for HR usage

• Good knowledge of Swiss employment law; interest in international HR topics

• Excellent written and spoken English and German

• Structured, independent, and service-oriented way of working with a high level of discretion

• Available at short notice or within a reasonable timeframe for a 16-month assignment

What Sets You Apart

• You keep the overview even with parallel projects and tight deadlines

• You communicate effectively with all audiences – from the shop floor to senior management

• You combine a hands-on mentality with conceptual thinking

• Discretion and sensitivity in handling confidential topics come naturally to you

• W hat makes working at Tecan unique

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology # HRBP

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Männedorf, Zurigo

• Agire come interfaccia ai servizi HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition e Centri di competenza

Il tuo sfondo

• Completato l'istruzione con ulteriore qualifica in HR (ad esempio, diploma federale svizzero in HR, laurea in CAS/Bachelor in HR o Business Administration)

• 3–5+ anni di esperienza come Generalista HR, idealmente in un ambiente internazionale matrice-organizzato

• Esperienza che contribuisce o conduce progetti HR

• Forte capacità di PowerPoint ed Excel; lavoro sicuro con i sistemi HR (ad esempio, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday)

• Forte interesse a spingere AI per l'utilizzo HR

• Buona conoscenza del diritto del lavoro svizzero; interesse per gli argomenti internazionali delle risorse umane

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese e tedesco

• Strutturato, indipendente e orientato al servizio, con un alto livello di discrezione

• Disponibile a breve preavviso o entro un termine ragionevole per un incarico di 16 mesi

Cosa ti distingue

• Tieni la panoramica anche con progetti paralleli e scadenze strette

• Si comunica efficacemente con tutti i pubblici – dal piano del negozio alla gestione senior

• Unisci una mentalità pratica con il pensiero concettuale

• La discrezionalità e la sensibilità nel trattare argomenti confidenziali vengono naturalmente a voi

• Cappello W fa lavorare a Tecan unico

• La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Saranno considerate solo le applicazioni che soddisfano pienamente i nostri requisiti.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology # HRBP

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

Field Automation Engineer

Full-Time

Make an Impact With Our Team

In this role, you will serve as a customer-facing technical resource supporting Tecan automation systems through preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, installation support, and customer service activities. You will partner closely with Field Automation Engineers, customers, Sales teams, and internal technical groups to ensure instrument reliability and customer satisfaction.

You will provide hands-on technical expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, including system maintenance, diagnostics, troubleshooting, documentation, training support, and workflow assistance.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and supporting innovative laboratory automation technologies, we encourage you to apply.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our  Field Service  team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Your contribution:

• Install, develop and implement applications, integrations, mechanical service, customer training, and sales demonstrations of applications on Tecan liquid handling platforms, including EVO and/or FLUENT.

• Performs instrument installation, integration of third-party devices and development of software applications by writing Evoware  and/or Fluent  scripts.

• Performs problem diagnosis, service, and preventative maintenance on Tecan instruments.

• Performs complex software application development, including developing liquid classes, and device integration at customer sites

• Provides customer training on use, application development maintenance, and troubleshooting.

• Share information obtained from unique problems or specialized training to the FAE Team and the Tecan organization.

• Performs complex demonstrations and installs.

• Ability and willingness to maintain a travel schedule and to travel on short notice.

• Complete essential service records according to company policy.

• Maintains appropriate parts inventory by checking stock to determine inventory level; anticipating needed supplies; placing and expediting orders for supplies; verifying receipt of supplies.

• Provides back-up service support outside of assigned territory as needed.

• Maintains technical knowledge by attending educational workshops and reviewing technical publications.

• Handles essential tasks as assigned and responds to change productively.

• Follows all local safety procedures, State and Federal OSHA Regulations, and reports any safety concerns.

Your background

• BS degree in Life Science or Computer Science or equivalent industry experience

• Minimum of 3 years of laboratory experience working with Evoware,  Fluent,  Magellan  and other Tecan  software is desired.

• Minimum of 3 years robotics/automation experience and writing scripts is desired.

• Electro/mechanical experience a plus
